response.sql: WITH per_circuit AS (SELECT c.circuitId AS circuitId, c.country AS country, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.date > '1978-03-04' AND r.date < '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), with_avg AS (SELECT circuitId, country, race_count, AVG(race_count) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_avg FROM per_circuit) SELECT circuitId, country, race_count, CAST(race_count AS REAL) / country_avg AS ratio FROM with_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC, circuitId ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The country average is taken over the per-circuit race counts of circuits that have at least one race in the date window (circuits with zero races in the window are not included in the average).
Ties in the ratio are broken by circuitId ascending, since the request does not specify a tie-breaker.
